mapper.select: UPDATE planning_run run SET status = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, learning_task_id = #{learningTaskId, jdbcType=OTHER}, fallback_reason = #{fallbackReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1, workflow_version = CASE WHEN #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'FALLBACK_APPLIED' THEN workflow_version + 1 ELSE workflow_version END WHERE run.id = #{planningRunId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND run.user_id = #{trustedUserId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND run.language_profile_id = #{languageProfileId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND run.status = 'PENDING' AND run.row_version = #{expectedRowVersion, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM learning_task task WHERE task.id = #{learningTaskId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND task.user_id = run.user_id AND task.language_profile_id = run.language_profile_id AND task.planning_reason = CASE WHEN #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'MODEL_APPLIED' THEN 'MODEL_ENRICHED' ELSE 'DETERMINISTIC_BUILT_IN_FALLBACK' END ) RETURNING
